affected_party: people and AI agents relying on calibration to make governed decisions
actual_problem: A mathematically acceptable aggregate calibration score can hide an overconfident decision that crosses a severe loss boundary, because QIF v0.6.32 does not connect forecast thresholds, false assurance, false alarms, and asymmetric consequences.
why_it_matters: Equal forecast errors can produce radically different harm; treating them symmetrically can authorize unsafe reliance or hide the case that most needs governance.
why_now: QIF now reproduces calibration arithmetic and cohort integrity, so consequence interpretation is the nearest unclosed decision-quality boundary.
